name: Andromalius
depicted_variant: Goetic human earl holding a large serpent, returning a thief and stolen goods.

visual_requirements.description: Brings back thief and stolen goods; punishment

aura: Serpent attribute c03/c05 and active return of thief and goods c04/c05 create threat.
artistic_choices: Human form and serpent attribute kept exact; no horns, fangs or giant body.
Stone passage, dark mantle, returning thief action and tarnished cups are editorial staging of documented recovery.
Menace through looming close camera, serpent and forceful act; no invented visible magic.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Andromalius, the formidable Goetic earl who appears as a man holding a large serpent and recovers thieves and stolen goods.
ANATOMY: one adult male in fully opaque weathered dark medieval mantle and tunic, ONE human head, two eyes, two arms and two legs, human face without horns or fangs; his right hand holds ONE LARGE living SERPENT firmly behind its head, serpent body coils across his forearm then descends visibly; serpent one head and two eyes, no wings or legs [c03,c05]
MOMENT: Stride directly toward viewer, thrust the large serpent toward camera in his right hand while his left hand drags a terrified fully clothed thief back by the wrist; thief clutches a torn sack spilling a few stolen silver cups onto stone [c04,c05]
POWER: Recover thief and stolen goods [c04,c05], punishment implied by the forceful return only. No magical beams, no levitating objects, no supernatural glowing eyes, no invented spirit army
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; extreme low close angle, Andromalius and coiled large serpent occupy 85 percent of image; thief lower and behind but normal human proportions, earl NOT a giant
LIGHT & WEATHER: one torch outside frame casts dominant amber sidelight, hard rim light on snake scales and mantle, deep walnut shadows, airborne stone dust
SURFACE: weathered opaque wool, scarred ordinary human skin, leathery serpent scales, tarnished stolen cups
SETTING: a dark unlabelled stone passage, neutral editorial staging for return of thief and goods; no invented ritual circle or inscriptions
MOOD: dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoinscriptions, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film, game, anime or comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes. Strong painterly brushwork, not plastic 3D.
